name: WUP transmission lines (HIFLD, Nov 2024 export; geometry only)
source: HIFLD Electric Power Transmission Lines, clipped to the six WUP counties in Wesley Beck's ArcGIS Pro project TransmissionLines.aprx (2024-11-04). The county spatial join dropped the HIFLD attributes (voltage, owner, substations), so this copy has geometry and county only.
license: HIFLD Open (public domain, U.S. Government); see the source layer for terms.
attribution: Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data (HIFLD), Electric Power Transmission Lines
notes: Lines are split at county boundaries (75 pieces). For voltage and owner, download a current layer from the Lines tab (OpenStreetMap / HIFLD / EIA) or import the original HIFLD export.
